item.title: Correction · Pier 54: Pier 54 is now shown as existing, not being removed, and its page is titled…
item.description: Pier 54 is now shown as existing, not being removed, and its page is titled simply 'Pier 54'. The only evidence of demolition is a proposed budget line for the pier's shed in the Port's draft capital plan; no source says it has started. The summary no longer says the pier was 'condemned' and closed in 2024: the sources say it was red-tagged, that the Port recommended closing it for safety reasons, and that its 11 tenants were told to leave by the end of 2024, and the ones read were written before that date. Source: Port of San Francisco, Draft Five-Year Capital Improvement Program FY2027-31, pp. 5 and 10 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-02/item_10a.5_attachment_v_fy_2027-31_five-year_cip_draft.pdf); Port Commission memo, August 9, 2024 (https://www.sfport.com/files/2024-08/081324_12a_pier_54_tenant_relocation_rental_assistance_program_final.pdf).
item.source: Port of San Francisco, Draft Five-Year Capital Improvement Program FY2027-31, pp. 5 and 10 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-02/item_10a.5_attachment_v_fy_2027-31_five-year_cip_draft.pdf); Port Commission memo, August 9, 2024 (https://www.sfport.com/files/2024-08/081324_12a_pier_54_tenant_relocation_rental_assistance_program_final.pdf)

item.title: Correction · Pier 54: Pier 54's page now lists the right Board of Supervisors district (6, not 10)…
item.description: Pier 54's page now lists the right Board of Supervisors district (6, not 10) and no longer says the pier is on Terry A. Francois Boulevard, which no source states. The proposed demolition budget line is no longer labelled as public investment, since it is only a proposal in a draft plan. Source: DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Roll (wv5m-vpq2), block 9900 lot 054, roll year 2025; https://discoveryink.wordpress.com/2024/09/08/crumbling-sf-pier-closing-down-forcing-iconic-businesses-to-move/; https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-02/item_10a.5_attachment_v_fy_2027-31_five-year_cip_draft.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Pier 54: Pier 54 now sits on the real pier
item.description: Pier 54 now sits on the real pier. Its outline had been a rough box drawn in open water just south of it. The new outline is traced by hand from satellite imagery, so it is still approximate. Source: Satellite imagery, Pier & Point's own reading (Esri World Imagery, captured 2025-08-29).
item.source: Satellite imagery, Pier & Point's own reading (Esri World Imagery, captured 2025-08-29)

item.title: Correction · Pier 54: Pier 54 does have its own Assessor lot, number 9900054
item.description: Pier 54 does have its own Assessor lot, number 9900054. This record had said it had none, because the search used to check looked for street names and Port piers do not have one. The outline on the map is unchanged: it is still a hand trace of the pier deck. Source: DataSF, Parcels - Active and Retired (acdm-wktn), the row for Assessor lot 9900054, queried 2026-10-10.
item.source: DataSF, Parcels - Active and Retired (acdm-wktn), the row for Assessor lot 9900054, queried 2026-10-10

item.title: Correction · Pier 54: Pier 54's closure notice was dated December 2024
item.description: Pier 54's closure notice was dated December 2024; the Port's own memo shows tenants were formally notified on July 15, 2024, so it is now dated then. The February 2026 draft capital plan entry no longer shows as an upcoming event. Source: https://www.sfport.com/files/2024-08/081324_12a_pier_54_tenant_relocation_rental_assistance_program_final.pdf.

item.title: Added · Pier 54: New nearby-project record for Pier 54, closed and red-tagged in 2024 (SFGate)
item.description: New nearby-project record for Pier 54, closed and red-tagged in 2024 (SFGate). The Port's draft Five-Year Capital Improvement Program (FY2027-31) budgets $2.0M to demolish the pier shed across FY2026-27 and FY2027-28. Source: SFGate, 2024-09 (https://discoveryink.wordpress.com/2024/09/08/crumbling-sf-pier-closing-down-forcing-iconic-businesses-to-move/); Port of San Francisco, Draft Five-Year Capital Improvement Program FY2027-31, Attachment V, 2026-02 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-02/item_10a.5_attachment_v_fy_2027-31_five-year_cip_draft.pdf).

item.title: Milestone · Pier 54: A Port memo to the Commission on the FY2026-27 and 2027-28… (Feb 6, 2026)
item.description: A Port memo to the Commission on the FY2026-27 and 2027-28 budget refers to "the Pier 54 shed closure" as a factor constraining revenues, and lists the "Pier 54 Shed Demolition" among sample projects. (Feb 6, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-02-06.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 54: Port's draft Five-Year Capital Improvement Program (FY2027-31)… (Feb 2026)
item.description: Port's draft Five-Year Capital Improvement Program (FY2027-31) proposes a "Pier 54 Shed Demolition" line item totaling $2.0M: $500,000 in FY2026-27 and $1,500,000 in FY2027-28. It is a proposed budget line for the shed only; no line item for full substructure removal appears in the same document, and no source read says the demolition has started. (Feb 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-02.

item.title: Expected · Pier 54: Shed demolition is budgeted in the draft Five-Year Capital Improvement… (~2027)
item.description: Shed demolition is budgeted in the draft Five-Year Capital Improvement Program for FY2026-27 and FY2027-28 (July 2026 to June 2028). This is a proposed budget line, not a start date: no source read gives a demolition date, and the draft's adoption is not confirmed. (~2027). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-02.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 54: At the Port Commission's February 25, 2025 meeting, a member… (Feb 25, 2025)
item.description: At the Port Commission's February 25, 2025 meeting, a member of the public said in comment that Pier 54 "has recently been vacated of the businesses occupying it"; the minutes record the statement, which is not a Port finding. (Feb 25, 2025). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2025-02.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 54: Port sends Pier 54's tenants formal written notice of the… (Jul 15, 2024)
item.description: Port sends Pier 54's tenants formal written notice of the pier's closure; its August 9, 2024 memo says the 11 tenants will need to vacate by the end of 2024 (a planned date, written before it arrived). SFGate reported in September 2024 that the pier would permanently close at the end of the year. (Jul 15, 2024). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2024-08-09; SFGate, as an excerpt reposted on the Grassroots Actions blog (discoveryink.wordpress.com) on 2024-09-08; the full SFGate article was not read, 2024-09.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 54: Pier 54 is officially red-tagged, which SFGate (September 2024)… (~Jul 2024)
item.description: Pier 54 is officially red-tagged, which SFGate (September 2024) describes as deteriorating with no viable restoration plans. (~Jul 2024). Source: SFGate, as an excerpt reposted on the Grassroots Actions blog (discoveryink.wordpress.com) on 2024-09-08; the full SFGate article was not read, 2024-09.
